summary: Searches a linked list of resource data nodes for the first node whose name string matches the input, skipping nodes whose ID at +0x5C is -1 (unregistered), and returns the matching node's integer ID. Returns -1 when the name is null, equals the global default string byte_5EA438, the list is empty, or no node matches.

operations.description: A null name argument a2 returns -1 immediately.
A name equal to the global byte_5EA438 (default application-directory string) short-circuits the lookup and returns -1.
Reset the traversal cursor: this+0x20 = this+0x18 (list head); a null head returns -1.
If the node dereferenced from the head pointer is null, return -1.

Walk the resource node chain. Nodes whose ID at +0x5C equals -1 (guard 0) are skipped; otherwise the node's name is fetched via StringPointerAccessor and compared with sub_588410; a zero result (name match) stops the walk.
Advance the cursor: this+0x20 = next node (*(cursor+4)); when it becomes null the walk ends with -1.
Return the matching node's integer ID at +0x5C, or -1 when no node matches.

unresolved: this+0x24 (node count) is read per the field facts but is not referenced by the listed pseudocode; its role in this lookup is unclear.
The global byte_5EA438 is a default application-directory string; why a name equal to it is rejected with -1 is not established.
The -1 return value conflates 'name rejected by global', 'empty list', and 'not found'; callers cannot distinguish these cases.
The resource node type (StringPointerAccessor node, ID at +0x5C) is not identified.
